actions.action: Separate requested pickups from stock-backed commitments
actions.mechanism: Expected returns support tentative requests; only inspected, available items can back a confirmed pickup.
actions.implementation: Track out-on-loan, awaiting-inspection, available, and allocated states. Atomically assign one available item before confirming; display tentative requests explicitly.
actions.check: Simulate overdue returns and simultaneous bookings; no confirmation should lack an exclusive allocation of inspected stock.
actions.risk: Future bookings become less certain; explain their status clearly.

actions.action: Give every threatened reservation an owned recovery case
actions.mechanism: An overdue return triggers explicit resolution rather than leaving affected borrowers with an unchanged pickup expectation.
actions.implementation: Identify dependent requests, assign a staff owner and decision deadline, and offer substitution, rescheduling, or withdrawal through each borrower's existing contact preference.
actions.check: Inject an overdue event; every affected request must receive a case, owner, deadline, and recorded next step.
actions.risk: Unanswered contact must remain unresolved, not count as consent.

actions.action: Request consent for a specific inspected substitute
actions.mechanism: Item-level offers expose condition and accessory differences before borrowers decide whether an alternative meets their needs.
actions.implementation: Send an inspected substitute's differences through the supplied contact preference. Hold it briefly; allocate only after explicit acceptance. Reoffer if the proposed item changes.
actions.check: Reject and ignore test offers; neither may change the assigned item. Accepted offers must match the disclosed item.
actions.risk: Expiring holds can frustrate borrowers who respond slowly.

actions.action: Match alternatives across all affected reservations
actions.mechanism: Batch matching preserves scarce accessory combinations instead of letting the first recovery consume another borrower's only suitable option.
actions.implementation: Match inspected stock against recorded requirements, using pickup deadlines and original request order. Create exclusive offers; require consent for every substitution.
actions.check: Test two borrowers where only one needs a particular accessory; the matching must preserve that feasible pairing without double-offering stock.
actions.risk: Incomplete requirements can make apparently feasible matches unusable.

actions.action: Prioritize return inspections by threatened pickup deadlines
actions.mechanism: Inspection queues direct existing staff attention toward returned items that could resolve imminent shortages without bypassing safety checks.
actions.implementation: Link awaiting-inspection items to affected requests. Sort by pickup deadline, retain the full checklist, and record accessory completeness before availability changes.
actions.check: Return a needed item with a missing accessory; it must remain unavailable until inspection finishes and its limitations are recorded.
actions.risk: Urgent requests could starve routine inspections; monitor queue age.

actions.action: Add measured turnaround gaps to request scheduling
actions.mechanism: Explicit return-and-inspection gaps reduce reliance on immediate handoffs while preserving stock-backed confirmation rules.
actions.implementation: Use existing return and inspection timestamps to set provisional gaps by tool category. Offer later tentative windows rather than silently rejecting tight requests.
actions.check: Compare threatened pickups and waiting times before and after changes; inspect cancellations and refused requests alongside any apparent improvement.
actions.risk: Oversized gaps reduce access without necessarily preventing failures.

actions.action: Audit failed pickups against an immutable request cohort
actions.mechanism: Keeping original requests in the denominator prevents cancellations and rescheduling from disguising service failures.
actions.implementation: Record original windows, cancellations, shifts, outcomes, inspected-stock snapshots, and consent events. Audit failures for feasible stock-backed recovery using information available before pickup.
actions.check: Cancel a difficult test booking; it must remain in cohort reporting. Count preventability only when a feasible recovery is evidenced.
actions.risk: Unknown consent makes some failures indeterminate; report those separately.
